This timeline outlines the topics covered, suggested textbook readings, and important assessments for each week.

| Week / Date | Lectures | Suggested Reading | Assessment / Due |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Week 1**<br>Sep 8–13 | Introduction; what regression is; data visualisation; covariance and correlation.<br>Correlation and its test; data collection and the regression process; the simple linear regression model. | Kutner 1.1–1.3<br>Kutner 2.11 | |
| **Week 2**<br>Sep 14–20 | Least squares estimation; the Gauss–Markov theorem; interpretation of σ²; fitted values and residuals.<br>Inference on the regression parameters: confidence intervals and hypothesis tests. | Kutner 1.4–1.7<br>Kutner 2.1–2.2 | **Assign 1 out** (Sep 18) |
| **Week 3**<br>Sep 21–27 | Sampling distribution of the estimators; interval estimation of the mean response; prediction intervals.<br>Analysis of variance; the coefficient of determination. | Kutner 2.3–2.6<br>Kutner 2.7–2.9 | |
| **Week 4**<br>Sep 28–Oct 4 | F- and t-tests; descriptive measures of association; model assumptions and residual plots.<br>Matrices and random vectors; simple linear regression in matrix form; the hat matrix. | Kutner 3.1–3.3<br>Kutner 5.1–5.10 | **Assign 1 due** (Sep 30) |
| **Week 5**<br>Oct 5–11 | Useful matrix results.<br>Properties of linear functions of random vectors; properties of the estimators, fitted values, residuals and predictions. | Kutner 5.11–5.13<br>Kutner 6.1–6.4 | **Assign 2 out** (Oct 7)<br>**Quiz 1** (Oct 6/7)<br>**Project brief** (Oct 9) |
| **Week 6**<br>Oct 12–18 | The geometry of least squares.<br>Inference for the mean response and a new observation; quadratic forms; the overall F-test. | Kutner 6.5–6.8 | |
| **Week 7**<br>Oct 19–25 | General linear hypothesis testing; extra sums of squares.<br>Multicollinearity and its effects; qualitative predictors. | Kutner 7.1–7.5<br>Kutner 7.6, 8.3 | **Assign 2 due** (Oct 21)<br>**Midterm** (TBA) |
| *Reading Week*<br>Oct 26–30 | *No classes or tutorials.* | | |
| **Week 8**<br>Nov 2–8 | One continuous and one categorical predictor.<br>Interaction models; case study. | Kutner 8.3–8.6 | **Assign 3 out** (Nov 4)<br>**Quiz 2** (Nov 3/4)<br>**Project groups due** (Nov 6)|
| **Week 9**<br>Nov 9–15 | Polynomial regression models; centred predictors.<br>Variable transformations. | Kutner 8.1–8.2<br>Kutner 3.9 | **Project checkpoint** (Nov 13)|
| **Week 10**<br>Nov 16–22 | Model selection and validation: criteria and procedures.<br>Diagnostics: outlying Y observations, outlying X observations, leverage. | Kutner 9.1–9.6<br>Kutner 10.1–10.3 | **Assign 3 due** (Nov 18) |
| **Week 11**<br>Nov 23–29 | Influential observations; multicollinearity diagnostics.<br>Remedial measures: weighted least squares. | Kutner 10.4–10.5<br>Kutner 11.1 | **Quiz 3** (Nov 24/25)<br>**Project report** (Nov 27)<br>*Drop date: Nov 24* |
| **Week 12**<br>Nov 30–Dec 6 | Shrinkage methods: the bias–variance trade-off, ridge regression and the LASSO.<br>Project presentations; course review. | Kutner 11.2 | **Project presentations** (Dec 4)|
